## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- CADPatternEngine — replication (linear / circular / mirror)
- linear: instance_count = count; total = count * featureVol; emits .rarray
- circular: count instances over 360deg; emits .polarArray
- mirror: exactly 2 instances; emits .mirror(plane)
- featureVolume omitted -> total 0 but still a valid pattern
- count < 1 or non-integer -> failure

cd mcp-server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/CADPatternEngine.test.ts
